notes: 6 PERK MACHINES around the hospital. Pay and your survivor hits a bowl, smokes a joint or eats a gummy - with real hands, a lighter, smoke, a glowing cherry and a haze when it kicks in. SECOND WIND (1500, solo: get back up once / co-op: revive twice as fast), DOUBLE DAB (2000, shoot faster), QUICK RIP (3000, reload twice as fast), ZOOMIES (2000, move faster), KUSH TANK (2500, 250 health), MUNCHIES (2500, 50% more points). You lose your perks when you go down.

ZOMBIES DAMAGE FIXED: every gun is tuned for zombies and keeps up as the rounds go on. The pistol drops round-1 zombies in two body shots; upgraded guns hit twice as hard. Zombie health grows more gently.
PUNCHING a zombie now knocks it back and cancels its swing, so it can't hit you straight back.

FOLLOW THE PURPLE ARROWS: the doors now lead to the gun upgrader, which has its own room (the north lobby, behind the new UPGRADE ROOM barricade). Every door has a price sign, and the doors on the way say TO THE GUN UPGRADER.
The GUN UPGRADER has a new look: a glowing purple core with spinning rings that speed up while it upgrades your gun.
Fixed: an upgraded gun's purple glow could stay on that gun in multiplayer.
